_about: Retrieval gold set, two query types. 'paraphrase': phrased the way an analyst asks, deliberately NOT reusing article wording — tests semantic matching. 'exact': terse keyword queries using the regulation's own defined terms and body names — tests exact-term matching. A retrieval counts as a hit at rank r if the r-th chunk belongs to an expected article (article-level relevance). Labels checked against the article text; written by the system's author, so treat absolute numbers as optimistic.
